COMPUTER STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   A. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
